name: kivora
description: Monorepo for Kivora cross-platform UI packages.

scripts.publish:native: pnpm --filter @kivora/native... typecheck && pnpm --filter @kivora/native... build && pnpm --filter @kivora/native publish --access public --publish-branch main
scripts.publish:nextjs: pnpm --filter @kivora/nextjs... typecheck && pnpm --filter @kivora/nextjs... build && pnpm --filter @kivora/nextjs publish --access public --publish-branch main
scripts.publish:theme: pnpm --filter @kivora/theme typecheck && pnpm --filter @kivora/theme build && pnpm --filter @kivora/theme publish --access public --publish-branch main
scripts.publish:init: pnpm --filter @kivora/init typecheck && pnpm --filter @kivora/init test && pnpm --filter @kivora/init build && pnpm --filter @kivora/init publish --access public --publish-branch main
scripts.publish:codes: pnpm --filter @kivora/codes typecheck && pnpm --filter @kivora/codes test && pnpm --filter @kivora/codes build && pnpm --filter @kivora/codes publish --access public --publish-branch main
scripts.publish:upload: pnpm --filter @kivora/upload typecheck && pnpm --filter @kivora/upload test && pnpm --filter @kivora/upload build && pnpm --filter @kivora/upload publish --access public --publish-branch main
